At Travelers, our vision is to advance our ability to fuel analytic-driven business decisions by accelerating cross-enterprise collaboration and capabilities. The Business Insights & Analytics Leadership Development Program (BI&ALDP) internship is built for analytically driven students who are serious about launching a career in data and analytics. This is not a passive, observational internship — you will do real work, solve real business problems, and be evaluated like a professional from day one.

Over 10 weeks, you and your cohort of peers will be embedded in Travelers' data and analytics community, gaining hands-on experience in one or more of our core analytics disciplines while building the technical and professional skills that define a successful career.

Technical training is delivered to you by current full-time BI&ALDP participants — those who were recently in your position — giving you an authentic, peer-informed perspective on what it takes to grow here.

Housing: The internship program is based in Hartford, CT and St. Paul, MN. Positions are available in our business units and corporate departments. Subsidized apartments are available for students who live beyond a commutable distance from Hartford, CT or St. Paul, MN.

Positions are available from June through early August.

- Real project work aligned to active business needs across Travelers' analytics functions.
- Technical training taught by full-time BI&ALDP participants.
- Formal performance reviews that give you honest, structured feedback on your growth.
- Leadership exposure through company-wide events including the Intern Symposium and community outreach initiatives, where you will interact with leaders and a cohort across the enterprise.
- A collaborative capstone presentation where you and your fellow interns develop and present solutions to relevant business and analytics challenges.
- Leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
- At the close of the internship, high performing interns are eligible to interview for a full-time offer to join the BI&ALDP — making these 10 weeks one of the most important career opportunities of your academic journey.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

- Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or greater preferred.
- Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a STEM related discipline (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math).
- Data warehouse and ETL understanding with Python, SQL, and/or Snowflake.
- Knowledge of data lakes and/or experience with Databricks.
- Exposure to dashboarding, scorecards or other descriptive reporting tools.
- Knowledge of multidimensional data and open-source cloud-enabled analytical programming languages.
- Familiarity with agile concepts & workflows.

What is a Must Have?

- Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.

Company Overview

Realm builds AI for the mining industry. We integrate with existing mine infrastructure — cameras, SCADA systems, drones, and data repositories — to predict equipment failures, detect unsafe behaviors, and optimize operations. Our platform deploys intelligence in various ways to improve productivity and safety — monitoring PPE compliance via computer vision, optimizing froth flotation processes, analyzing longwall shearer performance, tracking MSHA citation patterns, and more.

Our founders started their careers at Palantir before going on to build Blend Labs (publicly traded fintech, founded as CTO) and Even (acquired by Walmart). Our leadership team brings experience from Uber, Metropolis, and other high-bar organizations. We're a small, senior team that ships daily to production mines.

AI isn't just our product — it's how we build. We're an AI-first engineering team that uses the latest models and tooling throughout our development process, moving faster and at higher quality than traditional teams our size.

Our culture values high agency, deep ownership, collaboration, and autonomy across a fully remote workforce. Teams here move quickly and make meaningful contributions to a product that shapes global industrial outcomes.

What You'll Do

As an intern at Realm, you'll work alongside full-time engineers on real features that run at active mine sites - not toy projects or internal tooling.

- Contribute to our TypeScript backend serving real-time mining operations data

- Build and ship features end-to-end

- Work on applied AI features using LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) for intelligent analysis and automation

- Contribute to computer vision pipelines leveraging LLMs and services like AWS Rekognition and TensorFlow

- Deploy code to production via Kubernetes with CI/CD

- Interact directly with users and translate real-world operational challenges into features

- Work closely with our CEO -- former CTO and Cofounder of Blend Labs -- and a senior engineering team invested in your growth

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

- Currently a Junior or Senior pursuing a BS in Computer Science or a related field

- Strong CS fundamentals - data structures, algorithms, and system design

- Proficiency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor)

- Comfort working across the stack, you don't need to be an expert in everything, but you're willing to figure things out

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

- Prior internship or project experience in a production codebase

- TypeScript experience

- AI or computer vision experience

Interview Process

- Engineering quiz (async, ~60 min) — 8-question code reading and analysis assessment. No trick questions — we're testing how you think about real code.

- Live coding interviews — Algorithmic problem solving and a simulated development task.

- Behavioral interview with senior leadership — Culture fit, working style, and past experience.

Why Realm?

- Work on mission-critical problems at the intersection of AI, security, and global infrastructure

- Competitive paid internship compensation

- Real ownership: your code ships to production mines

- Direct mentorship from a senior engineering team with deep startup and industry experience

- Dynamic, remote work environment with global reach

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

The Supply Chain organization is a fast-paced and dynamic environment, delivering world-class communications equipment and solutions for customers around the world. Our purpose is to deliver exceptional value and customer experience through agility, speed, and collaboration. We plan what products and services are needed, source efficiently and ethically from a diverse supply base, launch new products, make and deliver solutions on time, and exceed customer expectations through outstanding quality, service and support. We are designed to bring value, lead technology innovation, and provide Motorola Solutions a competitive advantage on revenue, cost, cash, and delivery.

The Motorola Solutions Demand Planning team plays a critical role in the global supply chain, ensuring that the company can meet the needs of its customers around the world. The team's primary responsibility is to create and manage the global demand plan for Motorola Solutions' diverse portfolio of products. The team works to anticipate the needs of a wide range of customers, from first responders who depend on essential devices like two-way radios and the supporting network infrastructure, to enterprises that utilize video security products like body-worn cameras, video management software, and AI-powered analytics. This requires a deep understanding of market trends, product lifecycles, and regional sales forecasts to ensure that all products are available when and where they're needed. Demand planning is also highly cross-functional. The team collaborates with many different teams to create a unified demand signal that is a critical input to the company's Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle, which is used to align business functions and drive strategic decision-making.

Job Description

The Supply Chain Data Analyst Intern will have the opportunity to manage a portion of a Demand Analyst portfolio, which offers real-time experience in demand planning activities. The intern will also be responsible for executing daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting to assist the planning organization as well as perform analyses and assist with projects cross-functionally within the broader supply chain organization. In addition, the SC Data Analyst Intern will be expected to complete a summer project that focuses on a specific deliverable with measurable benefit to the business. The summer program will conclude with a presentation of the summer project to MSI executives and senior leaders.

Preferred Skills:

- Analytical and Quantitative Skills: comfortable with numbers, data analysis, and statistical concepts and should be able to interpret data, identify trends, and use this information to build forecasts

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel: A strong command of Excel is essential. This includes using functions like VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, SUMIFS, and creating charts and reports to analyze large datasets.

- Communication Skills: clearly and concisely present findings, explain methodology, and collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders. Both written and verbal communication are critical.

- Attention to Detail: Demand planning involves working with large amounts of data, where small errors can have a significant impact. An intern must be meticulous and detail-oriented to ensure accuracy in their work.

- Problem-Solving: The intern should be able to approach challenges with a logical and structured mindset, helping to identify root causes of forecasting errors and proposing solutions.

- Time management: Ability to prioritize work between daily tasks, summer project, and other intern projects in an effective manner

- Teamwork: Ability to work effectively in a team setting to make decisions and drive results
